waypoints.name: Inverness

waypoints.name: Bealach na Ba
waypoints.advice: Bealach na Ba comes up 98 km in. Nothing on this route is higher. Next is Applecross, mostly downhill.

sections.advice: Inverness → Bealach na Ba climbs about 626 m in 115 km. This is the part worth slowing down for - look through the bends and use the pull-offs.
Bealach na Ba → Applecross drops about 626 m over 5 km. Brakes and eyes forward; the views are behind the corners, not in them.
Applecross → Ullapool is 80 km of getting across. Ride it tidily and keep the enthusiasm for what comes after.

scenicChapters.title: Inverness → Bealach na Ba
scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 169 km. 626 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: North Coast 500
scenicChapters.narrative: 626 m come off over 7 km at around 13.2%. The road gives back what the climb took, faster than it took it. Brakes early, eyes far ahead. A descent this long asks more of concentration than of pace.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

north-coast-500-inverness-ullapool.story: 294 km from Inverness to Ullapool, about 4 h 18 of riding. The stops in between: Bealach na Ba and Applecross. A steady touring day rather than a sprint.

places-abrigo-del-molino-de-bagil-maina.story: A 411 km round trip from Socovos - roughly 7 h 05 in the saddle. It goes by way of Abrigo de los Covachos, Letreros de los mártires, Queso and maina. The highest point is about 1,400 m. The line favours views over speed.
